conversation_block.answer: Factors that cause stock prices to increase: 1) Earnings growth (EPS beat) — company profits more than expected; 2) Interest rate cuts — lower rates boost valuations and reduce bond competition; 3) Strong GDP growth — signals healthy economy and higher revenues; 4) Low/falling inflation — reduces Fed rate hike pressure; 5) Positive market sentiment (low VIX) — risk-on buying; 6) Strong revenue/sales growth — signals demand; 7) Share buybacks — reduce supply, boost EPS; 8) Positive catalysts — FDA approvals, M&A, product launches, analyst upgrades. Examples: Apple EPS beat → +5%; Fed rate cut → tech rally; NVIDIA 80% revenue growth → ATH; Microsoft $60B buyback → +3%.
